header.data_stage: 0. No signal: no pixel on the ad account and no sign-ups recorded

engagement_sources.note: The user confirmed one of the two linked Pages and the Instagram account as theirs. The other linked Page belongs to another business, so it is not used as a source.

inventory.seed_note: No audience exists, so there is no seed for a lookalike. The customer list (paying customers only, since this is B2B) is the first candidate. Meta accepts a seed from 100 matched people in one country, but the plan builds a lookalike from it only at stage 1 (pixel firing) and only once it matches 1,000 or more people in the US.

what_has_worked.finding: No ad set delivered in the last 90 days.

lifetime_context.note: Both ad sets that ever delivered are no longer returned by get_adsets, so their targeting can't be read.

what_has_worked.advantage_vs_manual: not graded: nothing delivered in the 90 days, neither live ad set uses Advantage+ audience, and no ad set has ever had a sign-up (there is no pixel to count one).
what_has_worked.lookalike_ranking: not graded: the account has no lookalike audience, and no ad set targets one.

budget_split.why: No warm or hot audience exists yet. Warm gets 20% (an 80/20 split) once the Page and Instagram engager audiences each pass 1,000 people with no 'too small' status; hot waits for the pixel.

cold.exclusions: the customer list (order 3) once uploaded; the sign-up converters audience (order 5) once the pixel fires
cold.warm_overlap: accepted: the Page and Instagram engagers (orders 1 and 2) and site visitors (order 8) are not excluded, because Advantage+ audience picks its own people and excluding small warm pools would only narrow it. Warm and hot ad sets show those people their own message.
cold.why: With no conversions and no seeds there is nothing for manual targeting or a lookalike to build on. Every cold option is well above the 500,000 floor for a budget under $50 a day, so size doesn't decide it; signal does.

cold_options_sized.option: Interests A or B (two broad interests)
Interests C or D (two narrow interests)

interest_size_check.finding: The two narrow interests show about 0.27-1 million people each in search_interests, yet the US reach estimate for the pair came back at about 17-20 million. Use the estimate for your spec, never the size printed next to an interest.

warm.budget_share: 0% now; 20% of the budget, shared with the Instagram engagers, once both pass 1,000 people
warm.exclusions: the customer list (order 3); once the pixel fires, the sign-up converters audience (order 5) and the hot audience (order 7), so each person sees one message

warm.budget_share: 0% now; 20% of the budget, shared with the Page engagers, once both pass 1,000 people
warm.exclusions: the customer list (order 3); once the pixel fires, the sign-up converters audience (order 5) and the hot audience (order 7), so each person sees one message

warm_skipped.why: only 2 video views in the account's whole history, so the pool would stay too small

warm_skipped.audience: WARM | Ads | Engaged with an ad | 365d
warm_skipped.why: the account's ads have about 64 impressions in its whole history, so the pool would stay too small

hot.audience: HOT | Web | Pricing or sign-up page, no sign-up | 90d
hot.window_why: B2B: the 30-day key-page window is stretched to 90 days for a longer sales cycle
hot.budget_share: 0% until the pixel fires and the audience passes 1,000 people; then 10% (70/20/10)
hot.exclusions: sign-up converters, built into its rule (minus order 5)
hot.if_under_1000: it already uses the longest B2B window (90 days), so fold it into the warm tier until it passes 1,000 people

cold_next_stage.condition: the uploaded customer list (order 3) matches 1,000 or more people in the US
cold_next_stage.size: unknown: estimate_audience_size can't size a lookalike that doesn't exist yet; read it from get_custom_audiences once built
cold_next_stage.budget_share: 0% at stage 0; at stage 1, a test ad set against the Advantage+ audience ad set
cold_next_stage.exclusions: the customer list (order 3) and the sign-up converters audience (order 5)

audiences_to_create_note: Orders 1-3 are for now (stage 0). Orders 4-8 need the pixel (stage 1) and are specced now so they can be built the day it fires; they get no budget until then.

audiences_to_create.name: WARM | Page | Engaged with Page | 365d
audiences_to_create.source: the Facebook Page the user confirmed as theirs
audiences_to_create.rule: everyone who engaged with the Page

audiences_to_create.name: WARM | IG | Engaged with account | 365d
audiences_to_create.source: the Instagram account the user confirmed as theirs
audiences_to_create.rule: everyone who engaged with the account

audiences_to_create.name: EXCL | List | Paying customers
audiences_to_create.source: customer list upload (columns: email, phone, first and last name, country)
audiences_to_create.rule: everyone who has paid; not trial or free sign-ups
audiences_to_create.job: exclude from the cold and warm ad sets; seed for order 4
audiences_to_create.expected_matched_size: unknown: the list size isn't known and lists can't be read through the MCP; Meta shows the matched size after upload
audiences_to_create.segments_later: high-value, recent (last 90 days) and lapsed (no purchase in 180+ days) segments need value or date columns the user hasn't mentioned

audiences_to_create.name: LAL | List | Paying customers | 1% | US
audiences_to_create.seed: paying customers only (B2B: not every sign-up)
audiences_to_create.job: stage-1 cold test against Advantage+ audience
audiences_to_create.condition: only if order 3 matches 1,000 or more people in the US; below that, skip it and keep Advantage+ audience as the only cold ad set

audiences_to_create.name: EXCL | Web | CompleteRegistration | 180d
audiences_to_create.job: exclude from every cold and warm ad set; not a lookalike seed, because for B2B the seed is paying customers (order 3), not every sign-up

audiences_to_create.name: HOT | Web | Pricing or sign-up page, no sign-up | 90d
audiences_to_create.rule: URL contains the pricing or sign-up path, minus order 5

audiences_to_create.name: WARM | Web | All visitors | 90d
audiences_to_create.window_why: B2B: the 30-day site-visitor window is stretched to 90 days
audiences_to_create.job: warm tier once it passes 1,000 people; under 1,000, stretch toward 180 days and run it with the Page and Instagram engagers

setup_checklist.do: Install the Meta pixel on the site and fire CompleteRegistration on sign-up (in Events Manager; the MCP has no action for it).
Build orders 1 and 2 in Ads Manager and share their ids.
Upload the customer list as order 3 and note the matched size Meta shows.
Create a Leads or Sales campaign with no campaign budget, then approve the cold ad set payload (created paused) and turn it on in Ads Manager.
setup_checklist.needs_first: step 1, so promoted_object has a pixel

setup_checklist.do: Build orders 5 to 8, and add orders 3 and 5 to the cold ad set's exclusions (update_adset with the full targeting). Build order 4 and its paused test ad set only if order 3 matched 1,000+ people in the US.
Start a warm ad set at 20% of the budget, excluding orders 3, 5 and 7, and a hot one at 10% once order 7 passes 1,000 people.
setup_checklist.needs_first: orders 1 and 2 each over 1,000 people with no 'too small' status

setup_checklist.do: Run the skill again 30 days after the cold ad set starts, so there are results to grade.

exclusion_fixes.finding: paused; targets US 25-65 with no custom audiences, so there is nothing to exclude yet
exclusion_fixes.fix: when it runs again, exclude the customer list (order 3) and the sign-up converters audience (order 5); it uses manual targeting, so also exclude the engagers (orders 1 and 2), or switch it to Advantage+ audience and accept that overlap

exclusion_fixes.finding: paused; targets US 25-65 with no custom audiences, so there is nothing to exclude yet
exclusion_fixes.fix: when it runs again, exclude the customer list (order 3) and the sign-up converters audience (order 5); it uses manual targeting, so also exclude the engagers (orders 1 and 2), or switch it to Advantage+ audience and accept that overlap

changes_offered.purpose: The cold tier: one Advantage+ audience ad set optimised for sign-ups.
changes_offered.status: not run: blocked until a pixel fires and a Leads or Sales campaign exists

body.name: COLD | Advantage+ audience | US 25-65
body.campaign_id: <CAMPAIGN_ID of a new Leads or Sales campaign>

changes_offered.budget_note: The budget sits on the ad set, so the new campaign must be created without a campaign budget (no daily_budget or lifetime_budget on the campaign).

changes_offered.purpose: Switch the paused engagement ad set (adset-2) to Advantage+ audience so it can grow the Page and Instagram engager pools. The full current targeting is sent with one change merged in.

unknowns: Sign-up results: no pixel, so sign-ups can't be counted and no ad set can be graded.
Customer list size: not readable through the MCP; the lookalike in order 4 depends on it.
Engager audience sizes: Meta reports them only after the audiences are created.
